text: The customer is in a high‑risk tier, meaning their chance of leaving in the next ~9 months is well above the average. The biggest drivers of this elevated risk are the unusually many failed payments (5 versus the typical 1) and a high share of payments that failed (33% versus 7%), plus a very low average feedback rating of 1.8/5. Protective factors include having a scored support ticket and no low‑satisfaction tickets. Note: the model’s predictions are modest and should be used as guidance, not certainty.
